scientific_integrity: Proof uses classical matrix-tree, Chebyshev, and strict logdet-concavity facts, which are not claimed as original. Finite computation corroborates, but does not prove, universal statements. Historical priority is not independently certified; an equivalent historical continuous-design result may exist. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact global design theorem only for undirected Möbius ladders with one common unit rim price and one common rung price, independently assigned nonnegative edge conductances, and fixed total budget. Weighted spanning-tree sums are not general network failure probabilities. No uniform finite-size remainder is claimed for asymptotic limits.
title: Sharp rung-deletion prices and critical-scale D-optimality on Möbius ladders
